title: No Blacksmith in Israel
text: And no blacksmith could be found in all the land of Israel …

title: Sharpen Their Plowshares
text: Instead, all the Israelites would go down to the Philistines to sharpen their plowshares, mattocks, axes, and sickles.

title: Only Saul and Jonathan
text: … only Saul and his son Jonathan had weapons.

title: Under the Pomegranate Tree
text: Meanwhile, Saul was staying under the pomegranate tree in Migron on the outskirts of Gibeah.

title: About Six Hundred Men
text: And the troops who were with him numbered about six hundred men …

title: Jonathan Did Not Tell His Father
text: But Jonathan did not tell his father.

title: Bozez and Seneh
text: One was named Bozez and the other Seneh.

title: North and South
text: One cliff stood to the north toward Michmash, and the other to the south toward Geba.

title: Nothing Can Hinder the LORD
text: Perhaps the LORD will work on our behalf. Nothing can hinder the LORD from saving, whether by many or by few.

title: With You Heart and Soul
text: Do all that is in your heart. Go ahead; I am with you heart and soul.

title: Our Sign
text: … because this will be our sign that the LORD has delivered them into our hands.

title: Wait, or Come Up?
text: If they say, ‘Wait until we come to you,’ then we will stay where we are and will not go up to them.

title: They Showed Themselves
text: So the two of them showed themselves to the outpost of the Philistines …

title: Out of the Holes
text: Look, the Hebrews are coming out of the holes in which they were hiding!

title: Come On Up
text: Come on up, and we will teach you a lesson!

title: Follow Me
text: Follow me, | for the LORD has delivered them into the hand of Israel.

title: Delivered into the Hand of Israel
text: … for the LORD has delivered them into the hand of Israel.

title: On His Hands and Feet
text: So Jonathan climbed up on his hands and feet, with his armor-bearer behind him.

title: His Armor-Bearer Followed
text: … and his armor-bearer followed and finished them off.

title: About Twenty Men
text: In that first assault, Jonathan and his armor-bearer struck down about twenty men in about half an acre of land.

title: Panic Spread from God
text: Indeed, the earth quaked, and panic spread from God.

title: The Earth Quaked
text: Indeed, the earth quaked, and panic spread from God.

title: Melting Away
text: … the troops melting away and scattering in every direction …

title: Call the Roll
text: Call the roll and see who has left us.

title: Withdraw Your Hand
text: Withdraw your hand.

title: Total Confusion
text: … they found the Philistines in total confusion, with each man wielding the sword against his neighbor.

title: The Hebrews Went Over to Israel
text: And the Hebrews who had previously gone up into the surrounding camps to join the Philistines now went over to the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.

title: Those Hiding in Ephraim
text: When all the Israelites who had been hiding in the hill country of Ephraim heard that the Philistines were fleeing, they also joined the battle in close pursuit.

title: Beyond Beth-aven
text: So the LORD saved Israel that day, and the battle moved on beyond Beth-aven.

title: If God Is for Us
text: If God is for us, who can be against us?

title: Heart and Soul
text: Do all that is in your heart. Go ahead; I am with you heart and soul.

title: Saul Waiting
text: Meanwhile, Saul was staying under the pomegranate tree in Migron on the outskirts of Gibeah.

title: Ahijah and the Ephod
text: … including Ahijah, who was wearing an ephod.

title: Not a Sword or Spear
text: So on the day of battle not a sword or spear could be found in the hands of the troops with Saul and Jonathan …

title: Plowshares and Axes
text: … to sharpen their plowshares, mattocks, axes, and sickles.

title: The Holes They Were Hiding In
text: Look, the Hebrews are coming out of the holes in which they were hiding!
